current: qip_mesh::peer::PeerEndpoint::reserve_own_legs is the participant's step: every one of the node's own legs is put to its local gate before any of them touches the ReservationBook; if the gate refuses, the node reserves nothing, journals gate_refused and returns the Declined frame for the coordinator; if the book refuses any leg, the legs it took in that call are released again (whole or not at all).
